connector.name: Neemee MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP client library and bridge for Neemee personal knowledge management system
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package neemee-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pbonneville account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEEMEE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticating with Neemee API (required)

env.name: NEEMEE_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for Neemee MCP server (optional, defaults to https://neemee.app/mcp)
